hook: Is your cat hiding? It could be a sign of illness!
caption: Is your cat hiding? It could be a sign of illness! Cats often retreat when unwell, so watch for changes in behaviour. Have you noticed your cat hiding more? #CatHealth #PetCare #SAFelines #HealthyPets #PetTips
